ops.title: TestRestackGTPerBranchVerdict flakes on TempDir cleanup under -race
ops.description:
Full-suite `go test -race ./internal/cli/` intermittently fails with:

```
testing.go:1464: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat ...: directory not empty
```

inside `TestRestackGTPerBranchVerdict` — a **different subtest each time**, never
an assertion failure. Observed in 2 of 4 full runs on 2026-09-02 while landing the
graphite submit fix (0.57.0). It did NOT reproduce under `-count=3` in isolation,
nor in a full run against pristine HEAD, so it is timing/environment dependent
rather than caused by that change (the restack path is untouched by it).

The signature says something inside the test still holds or is still writing into
the temp dir when `t.TempDir`'s cleanup runs — most likely a child process (gt,
git, or a probe) outliving the subtest that spawned it. Note this repo already has
an open task about probe child cleanup targeting only the claude PID (8eac14c),
which may be the same root cause.

Not a blocker; it never fails an assertion. But it makes `task test` unreliable as
a gate, which is worse than it sounds for a repo whose ship command watches CI.

ops.text: A root cause is identified for the TempDir cleanup failure (named process or handle holding the directory)
Three consecutive full `task test` runs pass without the cleanup error
